Most people think software engineering is about writing code.
It’s not. It’s understanding the problem.
Anyone can write code. Building something people actually use?
That’s a completely different skill. Spend more time thinking before typing
Keep building

Things that have concerned me this week as a Software Engineer 

1. Me forgetting the syntax of various languages like Java, Python, and Angular without the assistance of AI Coding Assistants like Claude Code and Copilot, and the fear that I may eventually lose the ability to write code independently.
2. Whenever there is an error/bug that I ask the agent to resolve, I jump to the solution instead of understanding what actually caused it, which means I’m loosing my ability to learn from my work.

AI didn’t kill coding.

But it exposed people who never learned the fundamentals.

Learn the foundation first.

Then use AI to explain, debug, and accelerate your work.

Don’t learn how to prompt AI before you learn how to code.

AI should be your assistant, not your brain.
